column1: # The library's filters: which kinds a tab of kinds shows (`all` shows
# every kind), and its words; then how the files are put in order.
# The library's tools: what a press does, its words and its icon. Back
# and forward go through the places shown, as a browser's do. Up
# goes to the folder over the one shown; Import brings a file into the
# Phiegg space; back goes from an item to the library; Set makes a set
